title: Admin Access Recovery
description: Regain wp-admin access when locked out — wrong credentials, security blocks, two-factor issues, or corrupted user accounts.

steps.title: Confirm Login Failure Type
steps.instructions: Distinguish between wrong password, blank page on login, redirect loop, 'cookies blocked', or IP ban messages. Each has a different fix path.

steps.title: Reset Password via Database or WP-CLI
steps.instructions: Use phpMyAdmin to set user_pass with MD5 (legacy) or use WP-CLI: wp user update admin --user_pass='newpassword'. Prefer WP-CLI on supported hosts.

steps.title: Create Emergency Admin via WP-CLI or functions.php
steps.instructions: Run wp user create rescue@agency.com rescue --role=administrator --user_pass=... or add a temporary mu-plugin that creates an admin on next load (remove immediately after).

steps.title: Unblock IP in Security Plugins
steps.instructions: Check Wordfence, Solid Security, or host WAF for IP blocks. Whitelist your IP or disable lockout temporarily via SFTP by renaming the security plugin folder.

steps.title: Fix Cookie and URL Mismatches
steps.instructions: Ensure COOKIE_DOMAIN, siteurl, and home use the same protocol and domain (www vs non-www). Mixed http/https prevents auth cookies from sticking.

steps.title: Recover Two-Factor Access
steps.instructions: Use backup codes, disable 2FA plugin via SFTP, or reset 2FA user meta in the database. Re-enable 2FA after securing the account.

steps.title: Secure Account After Recovery
steps.instructions: Set a strong unique password, enable 2FA, remove emergency users/scripts, and audit other administrator accounts for unauthorized access.
